newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen weak on poor baht sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen weak on poor baht sentiment.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to be dampened by weak sentiment in the baht on Wednesday, brokers said.
"The shaky baht will continue to dempen foreign investor sentiment and this will continue until the baht stabilises," said one broker at Ekachart Finance and Securities.
The broker said most investors also awaited the 6-month unaudited results of commercial banks due next week. Some smaller bank results have already been reported.
The SET index on Tuesday ended up 13.75 points at 625.66 on 4.2 billion baht trade. -- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
